dwelling_habits.dwelling: Sandy flats and reef passes; sometimes leaps clear of the water.
dwelling_habits.food: Clams, snails, and crabs crushed with plate-like teeth.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Digs in sand with a duck-like snout, then crunches lunch.
dwelling_habits.mating: Live-bearing; pups arrive ready to swim.
dwelling_habits.socializing: May cruise alone or in elegant small squadrons.

fun_facts: Polka dots on a flying carpet — one of the ocean’s best costumes.
Those leaps might shake off remoras… or just show off.

dwelling_habits.dwelling: Coral heads and rocky holes across Caribbean reefs.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Night hunter with a leopard-print tuxedo.
dwelling_habits.mating: Pelagic larvae ride currents to new reefs.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Usually one eel per favorite hole.

fun_facts: Spots help it vanish against dappled reef light.
Open-mouth look is breathing, not a threat display.
